description: This file is a header file for the PTM driver related to the MIPS architecture, defining core functions, data structures, constants, and external references for the Danube/Amazon-SE/AR9 platforms in the UEIP project.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_get_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version (major and minor) for the PTM driver.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the PTM chip with the provided platform device.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_uninit_chip
methods.description: Uninitializes or cleans up the PTM chip.

methods.name: ifx_pp32_start
methods.description: Starts the PP32 processor with the given parameter.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_proc_read_regs
methods.description: Reads the register values for debugging or status purposes.
